title: Server Launches 10/1
body:
After 3 months of hard work, we are please to announce the server will officially launch to the public October First. 

Starting Tuesday, 9/22, players who are whitelisted will be able to access the closed beta a week before the server is released to the public. The final wipe will be Monday the 21st, after that date everything is live.

title: The Launcher Has Arrived
body: The SkyMP launcher is now available. Stay tuned for further updates.
